firecrawl_scrape._discriminator_note: Confirmed: `formats` (array of str) selects which top-level keys the record carries — formats=['markdown'] returned {markdown, metadata}; formats=['links','summary'] returned {links, summary, metadata}. Array-typed, so one call can request several variants at once and no set of Literal overloads describes it (SKILL step 4 option 1 requires a scalar). Resolved as option 2: a generic base model over the union of both probes, total=False. `metadata` stays `dict` — its keys are page-controlled OpenGraph/Twitter tags that differ per site.

firecrawl_search._discriminator_note: Confirmed: `sources` switches the key inside `data` and the element shape under it — default/[{type:web}] -> data.web[{url,title,description,position}]; [{type:news}] -> data.news[{title,url,snippet,date,imageUrl,position}]; [{type:images}] -> data.images[{title,imageUrl,imageWidth,imageHeight,url,position}]. Array-typed, so overloads are ruled out (SKILL step 4 option 1). Resolved as option 2 at the envelope level: `data` stays `dict` because no single unwrap path reaches the records under all three sources, and unwrapping to one of them would misdescribe the other two. Keeping the envelope also preserves `id`, the searchId that firecrawl_search_feedback consumes.

firecrawl_monitor_list._note: Probed against an account with zero monitors: `data` came back `[]`, so the monitor record's inner shape is unobservable. `data: list` is hand-added per the shape-spec empty-list rule; do not fabricate an element model. Re-probe after creating a monitor to type it.

firecrawl_developer_search._note: Genuine prose tool. Raw payload captured via `call --out` is Markdown ('## [readme:python/asyncio] ...'), not double-encoded JSON — the guarded json.loads test returns NOT_JSON. `str` is the honest return type.

firecrawl_research_search_papers._note: Genuine prose tool. Raw payload is Markdown ('## [arxiv:NNNN.NNNNN] <title>' + abstract); guarded json.loads test returns NOT_JSON.

firecrawl_research_search_github._note: Genuine prose tool — Markdown ranked matches, not JSON.

firecrawl_research_inspect_paper._note: Genuine prose tool — the tool description itself states it returns metadata 'as markdown'.

firecrawl_research_read_paper._note: Genuine prose tool — returns in-body passages as markdown.

firecrawl_research_related_papers._note: Genuine prose tool. `mode` (scalar enum similar|citers|references) was swept as a description-sourced discriminator candidate: `similar` and `citers` both returned Markdown `str`, so the parameter cannot switch a structured shape here — inconclusive but immaterial, the return type is `str` under every mode. First probe (seed arxiv:2604.00965, mode=similar) returned the empty notice '(no results)'; re-probed with a canonical seed so probed_args replay to real records.
